newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA November commodity index down 1.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA November commodity index down 1.1 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) said its November index of of commodity prices fell by 1.1 percent in special drawing rights (SDR) terms.
This followed a fall of 0.2 percent in October, it said.

Falls in prices of beef, wheat, oil and gold were partly offset by rises in the prices of aluminium and copper, it said. In Australian dollar terms, the index fell by 0.7 percent following a fall of 0.7 percent in October.
